content_html:
watched #Tholiprema : hmmmm…..felt totally disconnected!!!! Need to find the reason why I dont like watching Love stories….still Thinking what was the last total love story i liked? (may be Love Aaj Kal? or cocktail? or Anand? or Godavari?)

Not sure when our film makers start making REALISTIC love stories rather than coming up with nonsense like love at first sight and giving the actress no other option rather than fallingnfor him jst bcoz the hero fights for her and blend them wiyh no sense scenes!!! Who the hell now a days get out of train to fetch drinking water from Tap _/\_ and more over Hero Heorine madhya ego problems Kushi nunchi chusthundhe

Having said that when all my friends liked the movie including my parents…..the only thing I can say is thanks to RGV for fucking up my taste for Love stories!!!

PS : when the whole Telugu states were gaga over Yem Maya Chesave…..probably I was the only one who hated it 😦

However Loved couple of dialogues “Devudike caste lenaapudu….afterall manushulam manaki caste endhuku uncle” “Manushulam….prema gurthundadhu thappulu okate gurthuntayi” “mqnatho kondaru prema natistharu, kondaru kopam natisthaaru…kaani mana medha kopam natichevaalle ekuva premistharu”…..Cinematography and visuals were excellent….Varun Tej and Rasi gave matured performances
